manifest.name: @bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail
manifest.description: DSH-Plugin: per-reply skill trail — truthful per-turn triggered/used tool & skill badges, folded from the session log (no model self-reporting).

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm types && pnpm bundle

bundle.text:
# @bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail — bundle patch layer.
#
# When this package is listed in a profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, this patch
# inserts the plugin row into the composed profile tree (the same mechanism
# the shipped @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app bundles use).
# The row is a consumer-only row (registers a projection unit + turnTail UI;
# publishes no service), so it sits loose — no isolate realm needed.
- insert:
    - id: skill-trail
      name: '@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail'

readme.text:
> **每條回覆如實標出「觸發了什麼、成功用了什麼」。** 基於引擎日誌的逐回覆技能/工具徽章,零模型自報。

> ⚠️ ** superseded by [`@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-ledger`](https://github.com/Bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-ledger) ** — this plugin's per-reply badges live on there (dual-seat, deliverables-safe), with the alternative-skill hint and the Skills tab. This repo is archived as the design-history record.

**[English](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh.md)**
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin
that renders a compact trail under every assistant reply: which **skills were
triggered** (🧠) and which **tools were actually used** (✓) or failed (✗).

```
🧩 技能軌跡  [🧠 ak-hk-stock-dd ✓]  [read ×3 ✓]  [bash ×2 ✓]  [web_search ✗]
```

The badges are **not** produced by the model. A `skillTrail` session-projection
unit (Host) folds each session's **committed log** — every `tool/call` event
becomes a triggered entry; the paired `tool/result` (matched by `callId`)
settles it as `ok` / `err`. The Client reads the finished value through
`useProjection('skillTrail')` and renders it in the zero-risk
`conversation.chat.turnTail` slot.

- ✅ Structural — the platform records, nobody self-reports
- ✅ Replayable — projection folds are pure; persisted cache + cold-start
  backfill come from the DSH projection subsystem for free
- ✅ Per-turn — each reply shows exactly its own turn's trail
- ✅ Skill-aware — `skill` tool calls render as 🧠 with the resolved skill name

The package ships a Host half (`lib/index.js`) and a browser Client half
(`lib/client.js`, `window.__ModuleLoader__` closure-factory format).

readme.section: Path A — Host composition (always-on, every session & preset)

readme.text:
Add one row to your preset's `agent.cordis.yml` (a consumer-only row — it
publishes no service, so it sits loose; no `isolate` realm needed):

```yaml
- id: skill-trail
  name: '@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail'
```

Inside a session, `@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail` can also be run through the
dynamic Cordis flow; prefer A or B for anything standing.

- DSH `>= 0.1.0-rc.6` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection` mounted in the
  host composition — it is part of the shipped `dsh-base` bundle)
- Browser UI needs the `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot (shipped chat view)

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxTurns` | `500` | Turns retained per session; oldest pruned first |
| `maxCallsPerTurn` | `50` | Triggered-entry cap per turn (wire-payload guard) |

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build        # tsc declarations → lib/types + tsdown → lib/{index,client}.js
```
